query: SELECT id AS "id!: ContactId" FROM ((SELECT id FROM contacts WHERE partner_id = $1 AND COALESCE(status = $2, $2 IS NULL) AND (id < $4) AND ($4 IS NOT NULL) ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT $3) UNION ALL (SELECT id FROM contacts WHERE partner_id = $1 AND COALESCE(status = $2, $2 IS NULL) AND ($4 IS NULL) ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT $3) ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT $3) __ids ORDER BY id DESC
